name: Progress M-35
about: Progress M-35 (1997-033A), a crewed vehicle (Progress M), launched 1997 Jul  5. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (DK).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (1997 Aug  4), held fixed
docked to S17845; GCAT's tables give no later phase (undocking, landing)
